name: Orbiton 2.74.5
body:
### Terminal emulator related

* Improve support for `tmux`, `screen` and Kitty.
* Improve support for the Zutty terminal emulator.
* Fix an issue with the cursor being hidden when running under Konsole.

### Markdown related

* Make checkbox toggles undo-able.
* Improve syntax highlighting for Markdown.

### Copy/cut/paste related

* Paste diffs in a smarter way.
* Improve copy/paste for multiple platforms.

### Man page related

* Let Esc clear searches when viewing man pages.
* Remember the location when viewing man pages.
* Improve man page syntax highlighting.

### Hotkeys

* Let `ctrl-w` only cycle git rebase keywords when editing git commit messages.
* Adjust the `ctrl-r` behavior.
* Improve the `ctrl-b` behavior.
* Let `ctrl-n` and `ctrl-p` not jump between files, for some cases.
* Let `ctrl-g` jump back after jumping to a definition.
* Improve the `ctrl-g` behavior.
* Disable `ctrl-up` and `ctrl-down` when editing Git commit messages.

### Programming related

* Add initial support for the Tim programming language.
* Improve support for Object Pascal.
* Improve syntax highlighting of multiline strings for Python.
* Add support for `hare run`.
* Improve LSP connection/startup behavior.
* Improve the Zig template.
* Improve the support for Kotlin.
* Jump to the first merge conflict marker if the file contains merge conflict
markers. `ctrl-n` can be used to jump to the next one.
* Improve the "jump back" feature, after jumping to a definition.
* Improve function name detection.
* Add back generic syntax highlighting of unrecognized programming languages.

### Linux distro related

* Add `nixfmt` support + a template for Nix, ref #28.
* Improve support for `nixd`.
* Add initial support for `.nvchecker.toml` files.
* Add back the `lig` symlink in the Makefile.

### Various

* Improve the `shift-tab` behavior and how lines can be indented and dedented.
* Make it possible to indent and dedent selected text.
* Update gif recordings and `.tape` files.
* Make it possible to jump to letters in a case-insensitive way with `ctrl-l`.
* Add a menu option for copying the last used command.
* Improve the system font detection.
* Improve how single-line comments are joined.
* Add a menu entry for block editing.
* Support more function keys (F8, F9 etc).
* Add a menu entry for jumping to the next typo.
* Use shorter descriptions in the `ctrl-o` menu.
* Add support for `llmman`, ref #29, thanks @ericcurtin
* Improve the look of the "quick help" box.
* Improve how lines are split.
* Fix an issue with parsing given filenames with `+` in the path.
* Fix an issue with jumping to the previous word.
* Improve bullet point rendering in graphical book mode on macOS.
* Improve syntax highlighting for RST tables.

### General

* Update dependencies.
* Update documentation.
